summary: @nebula.js/sn-nav-menu preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute obfuscated payload
details: Package publishes under the @nebula.js scope (claiming author 'QlikTech International AB') and advertises itself as a Qlik Sense navigation menu extension, but its package.json declares a preinstall hook `node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/<platform>.zip to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and then execFileSyncs the Bun binary against a sibling file `math_init.js`. math_init.js is a 727KB `// @bun @bun-cjs` compiled blob with a rotated numeric constant table and hex-mangled identifiers (`_0x...`), unrelated to the package's stated Qlik navigation-menu purpose (whose React/MUI code lives in dist/). The payload only executes under the freshly downloaded second runtime, so its contents cannot be reviewed by normal Node-based inspection and it runs automatically on `npm install`. The scope/author claim to a legitimate Qlik ecosystem name combined with an obfuscated alternate-runtime dropper is the impersonation-plus-install-time-RCE shape.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
